args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@Gideon, here's the draft. I took the times from #inc-vtg-hartford. The timestamps convert to 10:42 AM CDT, so I've labelled them that way.

> **Hartford gate kiosk incident summary (Vantorre, Hartford plant), 3 Aug 2026, times CDT**
> - **First report:** 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
> - **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch confirmed it.
> - **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM.
> - **Status:** Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route. The channel doesn't record a root cause. The incident stays open for another arrival cycle. The separate status-page access issue is still being worked under INC-4821.

I haven't sent this to Mateo's team or posted it anywhere else. Let me know if you want it sent to them or changed.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident summary (Vantorre, Hartford plant), 3 Aug 2026, times CDT

- **First report:** 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch confirmed it.
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM.
- **Root cause:** not recorded in the channel. Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route, and asked that kiosk 2 stay powered on for the reconnect attempts.
- **Status:** The incident stays open for another arrival cycle. Status-page access is tracked in INC-4821.

Ruth, that's Gideon's summary with your two additions.
